summary: Negative years were padded before their sign: year -1 displayed as 00-1 instead of -0001. The fix writes the sign separately, then pads the unsigned magnitude using itoa. The existing display test in tests/date.rs gains an assertion for -0001-01-01. Blocked: a faithful verbatim reversal requires coordinated changes across formatting files because format_value was replaced by format_number with different argument types. Reverting the year formatting call alone references the removed helper; reverting only the sign block drops negative signs entirely rather than restoring the historical padding bug. No valid single-region reversal was established. No builds or tests were run.
